answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can trade. Spinning up a falcon-swift swarm of fake identities then costs real collateral per node, so sybils bleed capital instead of multiplying for free. Honest agents earn their bond back; cheaters forfeit it. Trust hardens like a ferrous beam under repeated honest settlements, while a lone unbonded newcomer stays as brittle and hollow as carved ivory.
